text:
Is it not madness, Lord? You, absolute
in beauty, power, intelligence;
You, whose essence is perfection
and whose sacred attribute is happiness;


You, to me—who am born and die like a beast—
You, to me—who inherit evil—
You, to me—a frail being whose impotence
bears only sterile pain as fruit…


You seek me, O God! You accept my love
as a victory won
by your love over my free will?


Yes, it is no madness: for lowly dust
it is worthy of your supreme power
to make capable of adding to your glory!

translation.title: To God
